name: Apollos
summary: A Jew born at Alexandria, a gifted speaker who knew the scriptures well. After Aquila and Priscilla taught him more, he greatly helped the believers, and Paul called him a fellow servant who watered what Paul had planted.

key_moments.title: Preaches Boldly in Ephesus
key_moments.description: Apollos, an eloquent Jew from Alexandria who knew the scriptures well, arrived in Ephesus. He was fervent in spirit and taught carefully about the Lord, though he knew only the baptism of John.

key_moments.title: Taught by Aquila and Priscilla
key_moments.description: Apollos was preaching boldly in the synagogue. When Aquila and Priscilla heard him, they took him in and explained the way of God to him more fully.

key_moments.title: Helps the Believers in Achaia
key_moments.description: The brethren wrote ahead asking the disciples in Achaia to welcome Apollos. There he greatly helped the believers, and he showed the Jews publicly from the scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.
